voice.speaker: agent
voice.caption: Books seventeen to twenty-four, all at once, in one tree. One agent for each drawing, one for each scene, and a sweeper for each book.

voice.speaker: agent
voice.caption: A hundred and twenty-five drawings and fifty-three scenes. Each one rendered, looked at, and revised, up to three times.

voice.speaker: agent
voice.caption: Then the run stops. The session has reached its cap. Seventy-one drawings made, and not one scene.

voice.speaker: sweeper
voice.caption: Book seventeen. My orders: add everything, and commit.

voice.speaker: examiner
voice.caption: Your commit says Book seventeen. It holds twelve scenes from books twenty-one, twenty-two and twenty-three, and nobody had rendered them.

voice.speaker: sweeper
voice.caption: I did as I was told.

voice.speaker: agent
voice.caption: Book eighteen's sweeper refused, and took only its own five. The instruction was the bug, not the agent.

voice.speaker: agent
voice.caption: Stage explicit paths. Never add everything.

voice.speaker: agent
voice.caption: And a book cut off half way resumes from a skip list. It builds only what is missing, and the chain from scene to scene holds.
